lesson: Calibri/Cambria ligatures break PDF text extraction ('restora on'): docx uses Arial, PDFs use Helvetica (pdfkit). Checked by job lint.
Pages ignores paragraph 'space before' and hung unattended on an unseen dialog: PDFs are generated headless from JSON (generar_pdf.js).
One role per entry: 'Assistant Manager | Shift Lead' in one line confuses ATS parsers.
Without a default resumé the CV is invisible to employers. Uploading a new PDF re-parses it into 'Found in resumé' suggestions.
In SEEK edit dialogs, Escape discards the whole form; close autocomplete lists by clicking the dialog title.
SEEK autocomplete only refreshes if you type all but the last char, wait 1 s, then type the last one.
SEEK search JSON works without a browser; job detail pages return 403 to non-browser clients.
LinkedIn drops characters when typing fast in long fields: set values with the native setter + input event and verify.
LinkedIn profile sections load lazily: check /details/<section>/ before adding items (we created duplicates once).
Turn 'Notify network' off in add/edit forms; click Skip on 'share this update' screens.
Public guest endpoints return search cards and full job descriptions without login.
Biggest token cost was full get_page_text dumps and step-by-step browsing: extract fields with javascript_tool; keep discovery/triage in scripts.

Applying via Claude in Chrome unattended: 22 min, 0 submissions (external ATS, unanswered screening questions, upload failures) and high token cost. Default is now prepare mode: scripts pick + build docs, the person clicks Apply.
LinkedIn guest search returns HTTP 429 after many requests in one day; one discovery run per day is fine.

Modes: prepare (scripts pick+docs, person applies), easy (+ Playwright SEEK Quick Apply with dedicated Chrome profile, answer.py rules, pending_questions.json), full (+ company forms, not built). Auto-mode classifier blocks creating submit bots; works in normal mode with user approval.

Per-job skills do not load in the 'skills' overlay; read them from the position edit form (/in/me/details/experience/edit/forms/<id>/) without saving. Trailing 'Server Side, Internet Design, Mean Stack' are suggestions, not the person's skills.

For software candidates read GitHub READMEs and package.json, and the person's website including its JSON-LD (founding date, job titles): the first CV claimed client sites used Next.js/Stripe when they were Astro, Shopify and WordPress, and dated a company 3 years before it existed.
Repos that are courses the person authored (learners write the code) go in Projects as 'author of'; tools used only there stay out of Key Skills but remain in the project line for ATS.

Before the master-docs gate, an independent reviewer subagent (hiring-screener + copywriting skills, evidence folder, read-only) found unsupported claims and weak bullets the author missed; run it on every new master CV.

Only tracked ads were remembered: rejected ads came back as new every day (571 of 1,203 ads listed on 2+ days, one 9 times) and their descriptions were fetched again. jobs.db keeps every ad with verdict, reason, description, fit and outcome; ads rejected under the same targets are skipped, and reposts under another title are caught by description similarity >= 0.7 (UGL 0.94, RPS 0.77; same employer other role <= 0.65).
SEEK allows at most 10 saved searches (alerts) per account; plan alerts within 10 and let the daily discover cover the rest. Save = heart button next to SEEK on /<kw>-jobs/in-All-<City>-<ST>.

LinkedIn job alerts: open /jobs/search-results/?keywords=<kw>&geoId=<id> and toggle 'Get job alerts for this search' (bottom of list). Perth geoId 106367577, Adelaide 107042567; a location= param without geoId is dropped.

Read every document in the candidate's source folder at intake, including university program content and skills-assessment summaries: a candidate's degree coursework (C++, embedded, control, robotics) was missed until 2026-10-31.

LinkedIn guest search answers HTTP 429 when rate-limited; discover now retries transient failures (0/429/5xx) in up to 2 later rounds (~90 s, ~300 s) and reports 'retried'. Test: test_rate_limited_search_is_retried.
One candidate's launchd job sets JOB_PACKAGE_DIR to the owner's folder; a manual rerun without it writes packages to ~/job-packages. Rerun with the same env as the plist.

JOB_PACKAGE_DIR now also comes from .claude/settings.local.json (common.setting), and schedule install writes it into the plist; a session opened outside job-harness had written packages to ~/job-packages (moved to the configured folder, ~/job-packages removed 2026-11-02).

CV date ranges now render with an ASCII hyphen (generators normalise U+2010-2015/U+2212); lint flags a Unicode dash in a date range and measures PDF layout from pdftotext -bbox (holes >90pt, non-final page ending >140pt early, heading stranded at page bottom, thin last CV page). Idea from ai-job-search; master PDFs built before 2026-11-03 still carry the en dash.

Visa sponsor lists (Home Affairs FOI: accredited Jan 2025, active Oct 2023 and Apr 2025; 30,487 names) are imported from a sibling project's SQL migrations via 'job sponsors import'; the daily package shows exact/likely/possible matches for the person only. A miss proves nothing; an agency ad names the agency.

Employer portals probed 2026-11-03: BHP=SuccessFactors, WA public sector=jobs.wa.gov.au, SA Government=BigRedSky (iworkfor.sa.gov.au), Water Corporation=LiveHire, Mineral Resources=careers.mineralresources.com.au; Woodside and SA Water answer 403 to a plain request. Most big WA/SA employers already reach us via SEEK/LinkedIn (one candidate's jobs.db already held 27 Water Corporation, 25 DBCA and 13 BHP ads).

WA Government Jobs (search.jobs.wa.gov.au): /jobs/search?query=<kw>&page=N lists 20 server-rendered cards (title, department, level, salary, location); each ad page has JSON-LD JobPosting (description, datePosted) and 'Closing at: Mon D YYYY'. Of 113 open ads in digital/environment/GIS/data on 2026-11-03 only 44 were found on SEEK: now platform 'wagov' in discover/triage/alive.

Closed LinkedIn ad (guest jobPosting page): <figure class="closed-job ..."> 'No longer accepting applications'. SEEK GraphQL jobDetails.job has isExpired, status (Active) and expiresAt.dateTimeUtc (closing date); a missing job returns jobDetails null.

First /job-tailor run (a .NET full-stack role, 2026-11-03): the separate reviewer caught a writer claim the master did not support (PostgreSQL attributed to the client sites) and found a specific employer fact on the official site; its suggestion to add a certificate was rejected (writers never add certificates). The keyword table missed the ad's hard requirement (.NET) because it only saw track keywords: coverage now also checks a list of common technologies.

Panel v2 (2026-11-03): board with drag and drop and keys 1-5, detail drawer (coverage, facts, documents, history, notes via tracker.set_note), open package folder in Finder, Embudo (funnel + calibration), Empresas (qualifying ads only, ranked by count > best fit > sponsor list, board filters apply), Descartados with rescue. Design came from a Design canvas the user approved; the user rejected the impeccable directions.

Do not classify an employer's site from its address or its job page: click Apply and look at what loads. A portal's job page often differs from its apply step (SuccessFactors and Workday open a login; some company sites open a plain form in a pop-up).
A cookie banner can cover the Apply button (iCIMS career sites). Open the preferences, leave the optional categories off, confirm, then click Apply. It is not a reason to stop.

Claude in Chrome asks the person to allow each site, and a site that loads after the click (an ATS host) can be refused mid-run. List the hosts to allow before a run, and report a refused host as 'blocked: site not allowed' instead of guessing what it asks for.
Forms that ask about working rights stop the run when answers.json has no answer for it. Ask for the wording at intake (still used only when a field asks, never in letters or free text).
